verdict.rationale: Intel's ARK specifications page (docs-13,14,15) does list some concrete spec fields (ECC support, vPro eligibility, AI framework support) beyond marketing copy, showing a genuine spec-sheet exists, and the SKU URL references clock speed. However most of the evidence pack is marketing-adjective-laden product-page copy rather than a full transparent spec sheet with test conditions for AI TOPS, power draw, or clock boost methodology. Missing for 10: explicit AI TOPS number with benchmark/test conditions, TDP/power figures, base/boost clock table with test conditions, and independent corroboration that published specs match real-world behavior.
